product.olivetti-netstrada-7000.summary: The Condor NetStrada with up to four processors and redundant storage as standard.
product.olivetti-netstrada-7000.history: Olivetti documented the NetStrada 7000 on the Condor platform in Silver and Rack cases under the same commercial name.
product.olivetti-netstrada-7000.architec: Drives could be hot-swapped in every configuration. The guide documents DPT Ultra Wide SCSI RAID, two power supplies and two fan assemblies.
product.olivetti-netstrada-7000.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-netstrada-7000.limitati: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
